job.title: Production Operator - Afternoon Shift
job.description:
Our client is a leading manufacturer of bagged concrete, mortar, concrete, and waterproofing products. With over 30 years of industry experience, they supply a wide range of innovative products to major hardware retail chains across New Zealand.
We are currently seeking a reliable and hardworking Production Operator to join the team immediately in Onehunga. The successful applicant will be required to pass a pre-employment drug test and must be available to complete two weeks of training on the day shift.

What's on offer:
  • Monday to Friday
  • Afternoon shift 2pm to 10.30pm 
  • $26 per hour
  • Supportive and positive team environment
  • Permanent career opportunities
The Role:
  • Operating machinery for filling liquid and powder products
  • Quality checking and pick packing
  • Manual handling and heavy lifting
  • Forklift operation when required
  • Maintaining health and safety standards at all times
Skills & Experience:
  • Previous manufacturing or machine operation experience preferred
  • Reliable with a strong work ethic
  • Good communication skills
  • Physically fit and capable of heavy lifting
  • Competent forklift operator with a valid forklift licence

Don’t delay, apply today! Please call on 0800 562 547 or send your cv to info@dynamixrecruitment.co.nz

job.title: Assemblers (Mechanical/Electromechanical)
job.description:
We are currently looking for Mechanical Assemblers and Electromechanical Assemblers to join one of our leading manufacturing clients based in Mt Wellington, Auckland.
This is a great opportunity for someone who is hands-on, mechanically minded, and enjoys working with tools and assembling products in a professional manufacturing environment.

Shift:
  • Monday to Friday
  • Times – start 7 AM – 3:30PM

Duties:
  • Mechanical and electromechanical assembly
  • Using hand tools and power tools safely and effectively
  • Reading and following assembly instructions and technical drawings
  • Fitting, fastening and installing components
  • Conducting basic quality checks and inspections
  • Troubleshooting basic assembly issues
  • Maintaining a clean, safe and organised work area
  • Working as part of a supportive production team

Skills:
  • Hands-on and mechanically minded
  • Confident using hand tools and power tools
  • Comfortable working with small mechanical components
  • Able to follow technical instructions and drawings
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality
  • Reliable, punctual and safety-conscious
  • Physically fit and comfortable working in a manufacturing environment
  • Previous mechanical assembly, electrical assembly, engineering or manufacturing experience is highly desirable
